origin: Crystalized scene: four procedural cracked monoliths from generate-atmosphere-monoliths.mjs with the owner-supplied crystal.glb replacing the entire central crystal/frame/fracture geometry via replace-atmosphere-crystal.mjs. Five parts: back, violet, left, right and crystal. Crystal geometry and all four source texture maps retained; high textures limited to 1024px and low to 512px.
attribution: Crystal by Zambur (https://sketchfab.com/Zambur), https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/crystal-ba43c7bbcca143c8ad2f77f5841b39de, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified by DRMVYZ: resized and positioned in the generated monolith scene; textures resized to 1024px and 512px. Surrounding monolith geometry/textures generated in-house.
